sourcesTried.name: Hugging Face Daily Papers (9/28 and 9/29 ok; 9/26 returned empty; 9/30 not fetched)

candidates.title: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
candidates.summary: Active Taskless Distillation transfers capabilities between models using only a single word from the teacher per prompt of task-unrelated text, extending subliminal-learning work.
candidates.signal: HF Daily Papers 9/29: 262 upvotes (top of day). Related HN thread on distillation policy: 'Jensen Huang says AI distillation is competition' 72 pts / 81 comments https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49879032
candidates.notes: arXiv submission date 24 Sep is just before the window, but HF featured it 29 Sep.

candidates.title: Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
candidates.summary: Merges RL-trained specialists (math, code, instruction following) into one student via multi-teacher on-policy distillation and addresses bias from domain-based teacher routing.

candidates.title: YuE2: Unifying Symbolic and Audio Music Generation at Frontier Quality
candidates.summary: A single AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers writes a readable score (melody, harmony), expands it into semantic music tokens, then renders audio.

candidates.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents: From Digital Programs to Physical-World Intelligence
candidates.summary: Argues VLA/world-action robot models encode task requirements implicitly in action sequences; proposes coding agents that write inspectable, revisable programs for robot control.

candidates.title: Groupwise Agentic Grading and Advantage Redistribution for Code Agent RL
candidates.summary: Binary test rewards give identical GRPO advantages to all passing trajectories; proposes groupwise grading to favor clean, targeted implementations.

candidates.title: TraceDance: An Automated System for Building Agent Behavior Benchmarks from Real-World Agent Deployment Traces
candidates.summary: Agent system that builds targeted benchmarks for user-specified undesirable agent behaviors from deployment traces (Anchor-and-Confirm retrieval).

candidates.title: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
candidates.summary: Frames visual backbones as self-modifying learning systems (title only; abstract not read).

candidates.title: MassAlloc Attention: Let Attention Allocate Its Own Compute
candidates.summary: Attention mechanism that allocates its own compute (title only; abstract not read).

candidates.title: CoWindow Attention: Full Causal Coverage Is a Collective Property
candidates.summary: Attention variant where windows collectively cover the full causal context (title only; abstract not read).

candidates.title: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity
candidates.summary: Sparse attention with log-linear complexity (title only; abstract not read).
candidates.notes: Submitted 25 Sep, just before window. Abstract not read.
